name: OpenRouter
description: Adds OpenRouter as a selectable session provider, over its OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint (openrouter.ai/api/v1) via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. Chat-only: no tool calls, file access or permission prompts. Configure an OpenRouter API key and vendor/model id (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5) per profile in Manage profiles. Experimental.
author: Cockpit
